landslides_landslide_magnitude.issue_diagnosed: Severe sample scarcity in class 2 (large/catastrophic, only 6 train & 4 test samples). Val split had 0 class-2 samples.
landslides_landslide_magnitude.experimental_action: Applied balanced sample weighting to penalize minority misclassifications and tuned regularization (lambda=1.0).
landslides_landslide_magnitude.governance_decision: Retain primary operational reliance on binary occurrence model (PR-AUC 0.8196); treat magnitude as secondary advisory indicator.

earthquakes_aftershock_hazard.issue_diagnosed: Class imbalance (~20% positive) led to elevated False Alarm Rate (52.5%) at default 0.50 threshold.
earthquakes_aftershock_hazard.experimental_action: Calibrated operational decision threshold on validation set (best val threshold = 0.68).
earthquakes_aftershock_hazard.governance_decision: Integrate calibrated decision threshold into warning level assignment to reduce false alarms.

cyclones_rapid_intensification.issue_diagnosed: Severe positive class rarity (5.48% positive base rate) suppressed recall at arbitrary 0.50 cutoff.
cyclones_rapid_intensification.experimental_action: Optimized operational trigger threshold on validation set (optimal threshold = 0.64).
cyclones_rapid_intensification.governance_decision: Enforce dual-trigger evaluation: Rapid Intensification probability combined with Saffir-Simpson wind intensity.

earthquakes_aftershock_count.investigation_outcome: Heavy-tailed swarm distribution with non-stationary clustered ruptures prevents tabular gradient boosted regression from outperforming the baseline mean. The physical Omori-Utsu power law decay is mathematically defensible and acts as the official operational alternative.
earthquakes_aftershock_count.governance_decision: MAINTAIN STRICT SAFETY LOCK. Do not unblock.

wildfires_fire_duration.investigation_outcome: Extreme variance in burn duration (hours to months) driven by unobserved human suppression tactics and micro-scale fuel discontinuities. Loss function squares errors on outlier megafires.
wildfires_fire_duration.governance_decision: MAINTAIN STRICT SAFETY LOCK. Do not unblock.
